heuristics.name: material-and-mobility
heuristics.plan: Win material, and keep your options open.

heuristics.name: Grunt counter
heuristics.plan: Trade only when it leaves you with more grunts than the opponent, since running them out of pieces is the only win.

heuristics.name: Race up the board
heuristics.plan: Shove your grunts as far forward as possible and let the opponent worry about the collisions.

heuristics.name: Keep options open
heuristics.plan: Play whichever move leaves you the most available moves later, and avoid locking your grunts against theirs.

heuristics.name: Lock it up for a draw
heuristics.plan: Block files head-on and strangle your own options until nobody can move, taking the draw instead of risking loss.

heuristics.name: Own the middle files
heuristics.plan: Cluster your grunts on the central files where the diagonal captures cover the most ground, and ignore the wings.
